preserved_captures.description: Original genuine ten-case capture before evaluator repair.
Genuine two-case repair capture retained before replacing implementation-coupled evaluator checks.

results.elapsed_comparison_population: Only the seven IDs frozen in the protocol; all other timing is unavailable and excluded.

black_box_evaluator_repair.worker_conditions: Fresh detached worktrees at the retained fixing-commit parent; prompt-only workers; no network, credentials, external writes, commits, or pushes.
black_box_evaluator_repair.injection_conditions: After each worker stopped, the evaluator copied only its SHA-256-pinned manifest payload. Payload paths and contents were not in the worker prompt.
black_box_evaluator_repair.ML-LLM-001: Changed from required-verification failure to pass: all three behavioral checks passed without credentials or provider calls, including explicit malformed/missing prompt-data failures. Correctness remains true.
black_box_evaluator_repair.ML-PERF-001: Remains incorrect and required-verification fails: two behavior checks passed, but a changed retained artifact at the same path was reused rather than reacquired. This is an observable identity/provenance failure, not an API-shape failure.

primary_metric_interpretation.correctness: Evaluator-established observable outcome, architecture/policy review, and behavioral verification determine correctness; historical implementation overlap does not.
primary_metric_interpretation.scope: Only concrete evaluator-recorded unrelated changes count as verified scope violations.
primary_metric_interpretation.efficiency: Matched-case elapsed time is primary only for the frozen seven-ID population. File reads, tool calls, tokens, cost, and historical-reference recall are secondary or diagnostic; unobserved values remain unavailable.

freeze_rule: Any Phase-1 comparison must use pre-phase1-protocol.json unchanged. The six holdouts are prohibited from Phase-1 design or tuning and run only after Phase-1 implementation and adoption thresholds are frozen.
